snippet.title: PSYCHExFUSE - Official Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Conquer your self and escape a pastel-colored nightmare. Take a look at PSYCHExFUSE in this trailer for the upcoming RPG horror adventure filled with mystery, challenges and terror. Unite worlds - and your past selves - in an interdimensional adventure into the deepest depths of the mind. PYSCHExFUSE will be available on PC.
